class="article page no-article-survey" sc-render-smart-button="false" itemscope=""> <section class="article-container" data-stats-ve="35"><h1>Use Gems in Gemini Apps</h1><div class="article-content-container"><div class="cc"><div><p>You can create and save Gems to customize responses in Gemini Apps to your specific needs.</p>
</div>

<h2>What you need</h2>

<div><ul class="no-margin">
  <li>To create and use Gems with a personal Google Account, you must also be 13 (or <a href="/accounts/answer/1350409" rel="noopener">the applicable age in your country</a>) or over.</li>
</ul>

<div class="no-margin"><p>To use this feature, you must be signed in to Gemini Apps. <a href="/gemini/answer/13278668" rel="noopener">Learn how to sign in to Gemini Apps</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>

<div><p><strong>Important:</strong> When you create or chat with a Gem, remember that you agreed to Google's <a href="https://policies.google.com/terms" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Terms of Service</a>, including the <a href="https://policies.google.com/terms/generative-ai/use-policy" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Prohibited Use Policy</a>. Be sure not to violate others' rights. Use your discretion before you rely on, publish, or use content that Gemini Apps generate. Users with a work or school account may be subject to different terms. <a href="/gemini/answer/14620100?sjid=11338487797924397540-AP" rel="noopener">Learn more about how to use Gemini Apps with your work or school Google Account</a>.</p>
</div>

<div><table>
  <tbody>
    <tr>
      <td style="width: 100px;vertical-align: middle;"><img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/Rmq_i6eo9VRLEb86pHoZpBts7P0wuus3ezMj3-vsZR5RvjZ4TnkGBs-2Yv8AtQkaREQ=w180" width="90" height="auto" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/Rmq_i6eo9VRLEb86pHoZpBts7P0wuus3ezMj3-vsZR5RvjZ4TnkGBs-2Yv8AtQkaREQ"></td>
      <td>
      <p><strong>Learn how to get started with Gems</strong></p>

      <p>Use the Gems guide to get ideas for how to use Gems, learn how to get a quick start with premade Gems, and find suggestions for writing great Gem instructions.</p>

      <p><a class="btn btn-raised" href="https://support.google.com/gemini?p=gems_guide_hc" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Get started</a></p>
      </td>
    </tr>
  </tbody>
</table>
</div>

<gkms-context-selector id="15158061"></gkms-context-selector><h2>&nbsp;Create, use &amp; manage Gems</h2>

<div><p><strong>Important</strong>:</p>

<ul>
  <li>For now, Gems can’t be used with Gemini Live.</li>
  <li>The Learning coach premade Gem doesn’t currently support language learning.</li>
</ul>
</div>

<h3 id="create">Create a Gem</h3>

<p><strong>Important: </strong>When you create a Gem in the Gemini web app, it will appear in the Gemini mobile app and the Gemini side panel in Google Workspace.</p>

<div><ol>
  <li>On your computer, go to <a href="https://gemini.google.com" rel="noopener" target="_blank">gemini.google.com</a>.</li>
  <li>Click Open Sidebar <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2">.</li>
  <li>Click Gems <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/Pwnkf7kO0dqxpvPvUpGTt33VSuRZMgLcc41eC43ayAk4NH3AeYnORu5LFI2TEj4qsnk=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/Pwnkf7kO0dqxpvPvUpGTt33VSuRZMgLcc41eC43ayAk4NH3AeYnORu5LFI2TEj4qsnk">.
    <ul>
      <li>If you’ve never made a Gem before, first click Settings and help <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/YNK3Yx6k5bOVlKmC2LdZOnKmmmXmnYH9lsM1wlxu7PBrmZKWU59xcpRaqAF9qCi8dT20=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/YNK3Yx6k5bOVlKmC2LdZOnKmmmXmnYH9lsM1wlxu7PBrmZKWU59xcpRaqAF9qCi8dT20"> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> Gems <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/Pwnkf7kO0dqxpvPvUpGTt33VSuRZMgLcc41eC43ayAk4NH3AeYnORu5LFI2TEj4qsnk=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/Pwnkf7kO0dqxpvPvUpGTt33VSuRZMgLcc41eC43ayAk4NH3AeYnORu5LFI2TEj4qsnk"><strong>.</strong></li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>Click <strong>New Gem</strong>.</li>
  <li>Enter a name and instructions for your Gem.</li>
  <li>(Optional) To add sources, under "Knowledge," click Add files <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/ZnxIaQhn2e_7LrN9FuAXtp5YSjXPfkqyIdYba4XV438cpOg3dPV0X00A52NEtfgJVqc=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/ZnxIaQhn2e_7LrN9FuAXtp5YSjXPfkqyIdYba4XV438cpOg3dPV0X00A52NEtfgJVqc">.</li>
  <li>Click <strong>Save</strong>.</li>
</ol>
</div>

<h4>Other optional steps to improve your Gem</h4>
<a class="zippy" id="re_write" name="re_write">Use Gemini to re-write your instructions</a>

<div>After a few words, you can click <strong>Use Gemini to re-write instructions</strong> <img src="//storage.googleapis.com/support-kms-prod/YD02gz6hnSz5dT060gyhPxlBZKa5tTgmiLrr" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/svg+xml"> to have Gemini Apps create more comprehensive instructions for most topics. It may take a few seconds for the generated instructions to appear.</div>
<a class="zippy" id="upload" name="upload">Upload files to give your Gem more context</a>

<div><p>You can add files to give your Gem more context or to reference specific docs in your chats with the Gem. <a href="/gemini/answer/14903178#add_file" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Learn more about supported file types and limits</a>.</p>

<p>After you add instructions, you can upload files. Under "Knowledge," click Add files <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/ZnxIaQhn2e_7LrN9FuAXtp5YSjXPfkqyIdYba4XV438cpOg3dPV0X00A52NEtfgJVqc=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/ZnxIaQhn2e_7LrN9FuAXtp5YSjXPfkqyIdYba4XV438cpOg3dPV0X00A52NEtfgJVqc">.</p>

<ul>
  <li><strong>To upload a file from your device:</strong> click Upload files<img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/7F81WckVz8ZLqCRQdkskz29zM_CbUslXVGROonY91A4QqHRxJkAEmRfnOYX1T87mPUAq=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/7F81WckVz8ZLqCRQdkskz29zM_CbUslXVGROonY91A4QqHRxJkAEmRfnOYX1T87mPUAq">.</li>
  <li><strong>To add a file from your Google Drive:</strong> click Add from Drive <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/G0gtMhFiQ4HhPVBnXnqrH6DX4JqcJrJ7OHCKmY-zOSmaI4T0aCDAiicTTbzhpgsPKA=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/G0gtMhFiQ4HhPVBnXnqrH6DX4JqcJrJ7OHCKmY-zOSmaI4T0aCDAiicTTbzhpgsPKA">.
    <ul>
      <li>To add files from your Drive, you need to have <a href="https://myactivity.google.com/product/gemini?utm_source=help" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Keep Activity</a> on and connect Google Workspace to Gemini Apps. If it’s not connected, you'll get the option to connect it. <a href="/gemini/answer/13594961#data_exchange" rel="noopener">Learn about your Gemini Apps and Google Workspace data</a>.</li>
      <li>If you add a file from your Drive, Gemini will use the most recent version of the file. If you make changes to the file, these changes will be reflected in your Gem.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li><strong>To add a NotebookLM notebook:</strong>&nbsp;click <strong>More uploads </strong><img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> Notebooks <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/Gpg_KhVUtsEnSV5BeN_6Q79Q6dAN_nf8Fc9NZAyOhHboJRLiCyBeBU2gTYBHDgAZ8VU=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="Notebook" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/Gpg_KhVUtsEnSV5BeN_6Q79Q6dAN_nf8Fc9NZAyOhHboJRLiCyBeBU2gTYBHDgAZ8VU">.</li>
</ul>

<p><strong>Tips:</strong></p>

<ul>
  <li>If you don’t want the Gem’s responses to include citations to your knowledge files, select <strong>Disable knowledge citations</strong>. This also disables citations for files uploaded in your Gem chats.</li>
  <li>You may need to scroll down to find the "Knowledge" section.</li>
  <li>You can edit a Gem to remove a file or add more files later. <a href="#edit">Learn how to edit your Gem.</a></li>
</ul>
</div>
<a class="zippy" id="preview" name="preview">Preview your Gem</a>

<div><ol>
  <li>In the text box on the right, enter a prompt to preview the Gem and make edits to the instructions as needed.</li>
  <li>Click <strong>Submit</strong> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/qlOH_KBmIELN9rCh2FBo4YALcMaIwgwsheZ0DaWz2N6w0ZoY6_nHRfukCX8kR-Sqxqpa=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/qlOH_KBmIELN9rCh2FBo4YALcMaIwgwsheZ0DaWz2N6w0ZoY6_nHRfukCX8kR-Sqxqpa">.</li>
</ol>
</div>

<h3 id="use_gem">Use a Gem in a chat</h3>

<div><ol>
  <li>On your computer, go to <a href="https://gemini.google.com" rel="noopener" target="_blank">gemini.google.com</a>.</li>
  <li>Click Open Sidebar <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2">.</li>
  <li>Click <strong>Gems</strong> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/Pwnkf7kO0dqxpvPvUpGTt33VSuRZMgLcc41eC43ayAk4NH3AeYnORu5LFI2TEj4qsnk=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/Pwnkf7kO0dqxpvPvUpGTt33VSuRZMgLcc41eC43ayAk4NH3AeYnORu5LFI2TEj4qsnk">.
    <ul>
      <li>If you’ve never made a Gem before, first click Settings and help&nbsp;<img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/YNK3Yx6k5bOVlKmC2LdZOnKmmmXmnYH9lsM1wlxu7PBrmZKWU59xcpRaqAF9qCi8dT20=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/YNK3Yx6k5bOVlKmC2LdZOnKmmmXmnYH9lsM1wlxu7PBrmZKWU59xcpRaqAF9qCi8dT20"> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> Gems <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/Pwnkf7kO0dqxpvPvUpGTt33VSuRZMgLcc41eC43ayAk4NH3AeYnORu5LFI2TEj4qsnk=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/Pwnkf7kO0dqxpvPvUpGTt33VSuRZMgLcc41eC43ayAk4NH3AeYnORu5LFI2TEj4qsnk"><strong>.</strong></li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>Under "My Gems," select the Gem you want to use.</li>
  <li>In the text box at the bottom, enter your question or prompt.</li>
  <li>Click Submit <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/qlOH_KBmIELN9rCh2FBo4YALcMaIwgwsheZ0DaWz2N6w0ZoY6_nHRfukCX8kR-Sqxqpa=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/qlOH_KBmIELN9rCh2FBo4YALcMaIwgwsheZ0DaWz2N6w0ZoY6_nHRfukCX8kR-Sqxqpa">.</li>
</ol>
</div>

 

 

 

<h3 id="edit">Edit a Gem</h3>

<div><ol>
  <li>Go to <a href="https://gemini.google.com" rel="noopener" target="_blank">gemini.google.com</a>.</li>
  <li>Click Open Sidebar <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2">.</li>
  <li>Click <strong>Gems</strong> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/Pwnkf7kO0dqxpvPvUpGTt33VSuRZMgLcc41eC43ayAk4NH3AeYnORu5LFI2TEj4qsnk=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/Pwnkf7kO0dqxpvPvUpGTt33VSuRZMgLcc41eC43ayAk4NH3AeYnORu5LFI2TEj4qsnk">.</li>
  <li>Under “My Gems,” click the Gem that you want to edit.</li>
  <li>Make edits.</li>
  <li>Click Submit <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/qlOH_KBmIELN9rCh2FBo4YALcMaIwgwsheZ0DaWz2N6w0ZoY6_nHRfukCX8kR-Sqxqpa=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/qlOH_KBmIELN9rCh2FBo4YALcMaIwgwsheZ0DaWz2N6w0ZoY6_nHRfukCX8kR-Sqxqpa">.</li>
</ol>
</div>

<h3 id="delete">Delete a Gem</h3>

<div><ol>
  <li>Go to <a href="https://gemini.google.com" rel="noopener" target="_blank">gemini.google.com</a>.</li>
  <li>Click Open Sidebar <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2">.</li>
  <li>Click Gems <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/Pwnkf7kO0dqxpvPvUpGTt33VSuRZMgLcc41eC43ayAk4NH3AeYnORu5LFI2TEj4qsnk=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/Pwnkf7kO0dqxpvPvUpGTt33VSuRZMgLcc41eC43ayAk4NH3AeYnORu5LFI2TEj4qsnk">.</li>
  <li>Under “My Gems,” find the Gem that you want to delete.</li>
  <li>Click Options <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/b71eih8vpqNx3eMyEn_d3TtszjcOGDLDRz6QuqbX8o86d5-7fD7EEiW_XqlkrtZJuuva=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/b71eih8vpqNx3eMyEn_d3TtszjcOGDLDRz6QuqbX8o86d5-7fD7EEiW_XqlkrtZJuuva"> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> Delete <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/ua10FFLX-w3-CybkL_041diO22Q7e1cl1OtevVyaY7KiPPTeg-Nl0EmoIrX3zjZ1BkRq=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/ua10FFLX-w3-CybkL_041diO22Q7e1cl1OtevVyaY7KiPPTeg-Nl0EmoIrX3zjZ1BkRq">.</li>
</ol>
</div>

<h2>Share a Gem or a conversation with a Gem</h2>

<div><p>You can share Gems from Gemini Apps or a conversation you had using a Gem.</p>

<ul>
  <li><a href="/gemini/answer/16504957" rel="noopener">Learn how to share a Gem</a>.</li>
  <li><a href="/gemini/answer/13743730" rel="noopener">Learn how to share a conversation</a>.</li>
</ul>
</div>

<div><strong>Important:&nbsp;</strong> Gems that are shared with you aren't automatically added to your Gem manager. Once you open the Gem and interact with it, it will be added under "My Gems".</div>


<h2><a id="experimental" name="experimental"></a>Try experimental Gems</h2>

<p>Experimental Gems allow you to try out early-stage Gemini features through Gems and share feedback. Experimental Gems are in development, and their quality and availability may vary. You can <a href="/gemini/answer/13275746" rel="noopener">leave feedback</a> to help us improve the overall experience.</p>

<h2>Why Gemini Apps might remove a Gem</h2>

<div><p>Gemini Apps may remove Gems when our systems detect a possible violation of Google's <a href="https://policies.google.com/terms" rel="noopener">Terms of Service</a>, including the <a href="https://policies.google.com/terms/generative-ai/use-policy" rel="noopener">Prohibited Use Policy</a>.</p>
Users with a school account or a work account that has Gemini Apps as a core service are subject to different terms. Learn more about how to <a href="/gemini/answer/14620100" rel="noopener">use Gemini on your work or school Google Account</a>.</div>
